Ana (PM): Quick sync — Q3 private deploy staging plan. Need clear sequencing: infra quotas, runtime canary, security review. Who can own order?
Mike (Eng - runtime): I can drive runtime canary and model pinning. Need infra quotas confirmed first though.
Kevin (Infra): Quota request sent to cloud team this morning. ETA EOD tomorrow. Capacity target: 8 GPUs for staging, burst to 12.
Lina (Security): We'll need the security checklist completed before customer data sync. ETA for review: Tue after threat-model session.
Sophia (Product Ops): Proposed rollout: staging smoke -> 10% canary for 24h -> 50% for 48h -> full. Need SLA rollback plan.
Mike (Eng - runtime): Agree. Runtime checklist:
```
- model_version pin
- KV cache warmup
- canary routing rule: header X-Canary: true
- metrics: latency p95, error-rate
```
Kevin (Infra): For canary routing we need a LB rule and a temporary VPC subnet. Can do by Mon if quota approved.
Lina (Security): Also require audit-log forwarding to customer KMS and retention policy set. That's a blocker for private deploy GA.
Ana (PM): Blockers summary: infra quotas + subnet, security audit log + KMS, runtime canary config. Owners: Kevin, Lina, Mike. Timeline goal: start canary Wed next week.
Sophia (Product Ops): Also raising dependency: support on-call must have runbook. @Mike can you draft a 1-page runbook that includes rollback steps? :memo:
Mike (Eng - runtime): Will do. Draft by EOD today. Rollback will be: scale down canary, re-route traffic to hosted variant, revoke customer keys if needed.
deploy-bot: Staging cluster scale-up complete (12 GPUs). Logs: https://ci/internal/12345 :white_check_mark:
Kevin (Infra): Good — with this we can do canary earlier if security signoff arrives. I'll expedite the subnet change request.
Lina (Security): I'll prioritize the threat-model meeting. If we sign off on audit log config, we can greenlight canary tomorrow.
Ana (PM): OK — plan of attack: Kevin expedite quota, Lina prioritize audit, Mike prepare runbook + canary config. Sophia to coordinate customer comms. Check-in tomorrow 10am. :thumbsup:
